title: Item:Kobold Butter

[[File:Kobold Butter orb.png|frameless|right]] [[File:Kobold Butter.png|thumb|right|upright|420px|Kobold Butter]] == Kobold Butter == Use this special bait to draw new Kobold scavengers to non-desecrated camp sites. Usable in extraction challenges. Note that Kolbolds who have been driven out of a camp ex. desecrated camp site will not return, even for tasty, tasty Kobold Butter. * Acquired by: ** {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, [[Bound to Character]]. ** Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]]. (Listed in the DDO Store as ''Kobold Butter Bait''.) * Usable in the following extraction challenges: '''Kobold Island:'''
** [[Kobold Island: Kobold Chaos]] ** [[Kobold Island: The Disruptor]] ** [[Kobold Island: The Disruptor - EPIC]] ** [[Kobold Island: Short Cuts]] ** [[Kobold Island: Short Cuts - EPIC]] ==See also== * [[Challenges]] * [[DDO Store]] - Challenge Tools [[Category:DDO Store items]] [[Category:Challenge items]]
